What is the y-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations shown?
problem.stimulus:
The solution to the system of equations shown is (x, y).

y = 2x + 1
y = 6x - 3
problem.question: What is the y-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations shown?
problem.explanation: 두 식의 우변이 같으므로 2x + 1 = 6x - 3이다. 양변에서 정리하면 (-4)x = -4이므로 x = -4 ÷ (-4) = 1이다. 이를 y = 2x + 1에 대입하면 y = 2 × 1 + 1 = 3이다. 따라서 y좌표는 3이다.
problem.explanationEn: Since the right-hand sides are equal, 2x + 1 = 6x - 3. Rearranging gives (-4)x = -4, so x = -4 ÷ (-4) = 1. Substituting into y = 2x + 1 gives y = 2 × 1 + 1 = 3. So the y-coordinate is 3.
